            if ((value % 1) != 0) 
                return value.toString().split(".")[1].length;  
            return 0;
        }

        function countDigits(value, decimalCount){
            if(decimalCount){
                return value.length - decimalCount - 1
            } else {
                return value.length
            }
        }

        function getDigitZeros(digitCount){
            let digitString = ''
            switch(digitCount) {
                case 1:
                    digitString = '0'
                    break;
                case 2:
                    digitString = '00'
                    break;
                case 3:
                    digitString = '000'
                    break;
                case 4:
                    digitString = '0000'
                    break;
                default:
                    digitString = '0'
            } 
            return digitString
        }

        function getDecimalZeros(decimalCount){
            let decimalString = ''
            switch(decimalCount) {
                case 1:
                    decimalString = '.0'
                    break;
                case 2:
                    decimalString = '.00'
                    break;
                case 3:
                    decimalString = '.000'
                    break;

            }

        }
